name: clean-tag-count-with-tests
title: A clean feature diff with meaningful colocated tests

task.title: Distinct tag count in the footer
task.goal: Show how many distinct tags are in use in the footer.
deliverables: src/features/tag-count/index.ts registers a footer slot item
Wording is singular for one tag and plural otherwise
definitionOfDone: An empty list reads 0 tags in use
Two todos sharing a tag read 1 tag in use
Colocated tests cover empty, shared and plural cases

diff.patch:
diff --git a/src/features/tag-count/index.ts b/src/features/tag-count/index.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/tag-count/index.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+import { defineFeature } from '../registry'
+
+export function tagLabel(tags: string[][]): string {
+  const distinct = new Set(tags.flat()).size
+  return distinct === 1 ? '1 tag in use' : `${distinct} tags in use`
+}
+
+export default defineFeature({
+  id: 'tag-count',
+  register({ slots, store }) {
+    slots.register({
+      id: 'tag-count',
+      slot: 'footer',
+      render: () => {
+        const node = document.createElement('span')
+        node.textContent = tagLabel(store.all().map((todo) => todo.tags))
+        return node
+      },
+    })
+  },
+})
+
diff --git a/src/features/tag-count/index.test.ts b/src/features/tag-count/index.test.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/tag-count/index.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test'
+import { tagLabel } from './index'
+
+describe('tagLabel', () => {
+  test('an empty list reads 0 tags in use', () => {
+    expect(tagLabel([])).toBe('0 tags in use')
+  })
+
+  test('one tag shared by two todos is singular', () => {
+    expect(tagLabel([['home'], ['home']])).toBe('1 tag in use')
+  })
+
+  test('two distinct tags is plural', () => {
+    expect(tagLabel([['home'], ['work']])).toBe('2 tags in use')
+  })
+})

expected.rationale: A new feature folder with colocated tests, every changed file inside the lane, and a green suite. Nothing to fix.
